title: Bishkek State University signed a memorandum of cooperation with Assumption University (Bangkok, Thailand)

blocks.text: From April 28 to May 3 of this year, Bishkek State University (BSU), represented by the representative of the faculty of pedagogical education, M.A. Muratalieva, took part in the work of the international educational forum “Thailand–Central Asia International Education Consortium Cooperation Forum”, held at Assumption University (Bangkok, Thailand).

During the visit, a memorandum of cooperation was signed between Bishkek State University and Assumption University. The document provides for the development of partnerships in the field of academic mobility, the implementation of joint educational programs, scientific research, and the exchange of experience between teachers and students.

The delegation from Central Asia was represented by leading universities of Kyrgyzstan and Kazakhstan. On behalf of the BSU management, M.A. Muratalieva confirmed the university's interest in developing sustainable international cooperation and expressed gratitude to the management of Assumption University for organizing the forum and inviting participation.

Bishkek Mamlekettik University Assumption University (Bangkok, Thailand) menen kyzmattashtyk tuuraluu memorandumga kol koidu.

Ushul zhyldyn 28-aprelinen 3-mayyn Cheyin K. Karasaev atyndagy Bishkek mamlekettik universityinin Pedagogikalyk bilim beruu facultinin okulu M.A. Muratalieva arkyluu Thailanddagy Assumption University basasynda өtkөn “Thailand–Central Asia International Education Consortium Cooperation Forum” attuu el aralyk bilim beruu forumuna katyshty.

Ish sapardyn alkagynda Bishkek mamlekettik universityi menen Assumption University ortosunda kyzmattashtyk zhonundo memorandumga kol koyuldu. Bul document academiyalyk mobileduluk jatynda ononoktөshtuk mamilelerdi onүkturuүnү, birgeleshken bilim beruu programlaryn ishke ashyruunu, ilimiy izildөolөrdu zhurgүzүүnү, oshondoy ele okutuuchular zhana studentter ortosunda tazhryyba almashuunu zhakshyrtuuga өbolgө tүzot.

Borborduk Aziyadan kelgen delegations Kyrgyzstan menen Kazakstandyn aldynky zhogorku okuu zhailarynyn okuldoru tuzdu. BMUnun zhetekchiliginin atynan M.A. Muratalieva universitytin turuktuu el aralyk kyzmattashtykty өnүktүrүүгө bolgon kyzyguusun bildirip, forumdu yushturgandygy zhana katyshuuga chakyrgany үchүn Assumption University zhetekchiligine yraazychylyk bildirdi.
